desc: Derive optimal structure: minimal flips, all 1->0 before 0->1, negative phase descending, positive phase ascending, and top-x optional S bits.
Implement the Python solution using the marginal-cost enumeration and O(N log N) sorting with O(N) pointer updates as specified in NEXT; enumerate all x, do not use ternary search.
Verify on the three samples and small random brute-force Dijkstra cases (N<=8), including equal C values and edge cases N=1, all identical, all different.
Finalize code reading stdin and writing stdout, with no hardcoded samples and Python int arithmetic.
